_comment: Ground truth for the album-discovery step. Expected values come from independent sources (retail/vinyl listings, Wikipedia mirrors), NOT from the LLM. `required` = core tracks all sources agree on, in original order. `optional` = tracks present on some editions; tolerated only AFTER the required ones. Anything else (bonus/remix/reissue tracks) must make the test fail. Verified on 2026-10-10. URLs for the 2nd and 3rd case were written from memory and are guarded by expect_title_contains.
